admin.confirmDeleteAgent: Permanently delete agent “{name}”? All their targets and sales go with them. Deactivating is usually better.

admin.celebrateHint: Appears full-screen right away on every open board — including the office display — and is logged in notifications. New deals are celebrated automatically; this is for manual congratulations.

admin.exportHint: A file with Teams and Agents sheets covering the whole year. Same columns as the Google Sheet, so it can be uploaded there as-is.
admin.importHint: Updates existing rows and adds new ones, matched by name — nothing is ever deleted. A file missing someone will not remove them.
admin.photoType: Unsupported format — use JPG, PNG or WebP
admin.changePasswordHint: At least 6 characters. Checked against a leaked-password database before saving.
admin.passwordTooShort: Password is too short — at least 6 characters
admin.passwordPwned: This password has appeared in {count} known data breaches — choose a different one
admin.passwordCheckFailed: Couldn't check the password against the leak database (connection issue) — proceed at your own risk or try again later
